This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/ Physical Mode).
2.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel appearing for the Opposite Party-State.

3. The present application has been filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. by the Petitioner seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Krushnanandapur PS Case No.25 of 2023, corresponding to SPL.G.R Case No.85 of 2024, pending in the court of learned Additional District Judge (POCSO)
Court ,Jagatsingpur, for alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n)/376(3) of I.P.C, and section 6 of POCSO Act.
4.
It is stated by the learned counsel for the petitioner that both the petitioner and the victim were in a love relationship.
He further contended that with each other's consent, they both fled away from the locality.
Thereafter, they got marriage and are staying together as husband and wife in Bangalore.
However, they were required to be present at their locality to attend the Suddha Ceremony of their relative.
While they were in the locality, the victim girl has been rescued by the police.
Since there is an apprehension of arrest of the Petitioner, the petitioner has approached this Court by filing the present anticipatory bail application.

sentences.text: 1 5. Learned counsel for the State at this stage produces the case diary as well as 164 statement of the victim.
On perusal of the 164 statement of the victim it appears that earlier the victim eloped with the present petitioner on 09.09.2022.
Thereafter, she came back to her parental house, where it was alleged that she was subjected to physical torture and harassment by her own family members.
Thereafter, she again fled away with the petitioner on 08.05.2023 and they were both staying at Bangalore as husband and wife.
He further contended that in the meantime both the victim and the petitioner have been blessed with a male child.

While they were in the village to attend the Suddha ceremony of their relative, the police has taken away the victim and her statement has been recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
6.

On perusal of the record, it appears that the victim girl, who was a minor at the time of occurrence, is a major girl now and that she is married to the petitioner and they both are staying as husband and wife and in the meantime they have been blessed with a male child.

Keeping in view the statement of the victim as well as the surrounding facts of the circumstances and the subsequent developments in the present case, this Court directs the petitioner to surrender before the Court in seisin over the matter within a period of four weeks from today and move an application for bail.

In such eventuality, the Court in seisin over the matter shall release him on bail in connection with the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
Violation of any of the terms and conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
7. Accordingly, the ABLAPL is disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( Aditya Kumar Mohapatra) Judge Rubi Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Date: 13-Jan-2025 18:22:48
